name: The Broken Seal
description: Makara ruins seal puzzle, door to Dark Shrine.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: Surveyors found something at Makara two days ago. A structure. Ruins, technically, but...

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: Our dating estimates put the construction at least a thousand years before the Great Blank. Possibly more.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: There shouldn't be anything that old still standing. There certainly shouldn't be anything that old still intact.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: Hunters who've approached the perimeter report hearing voices. Not animal calls — words. None of them speak the language.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: The surveyors also identified crystal formations in the deeper galleries. I want to document them. I'll need someone capable to escort me in.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: Dr. Carlo will be with you. Keep him alive. Let him do his work.
